newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hughes, Geotek in manufacturing alliance.
newsitem.headline: Hughes, Geotek in manufacturing alliance.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc announced it has signed an agreement with Hughes Network Systems Inc (HNS) for the manufacture, sale and financing of equipment based on Geotek's FHMA technology.
HNS agreed to manufacture FHMA infrastructure subsystems for Geotek and to provide Geotek with $100 million in vendor credit financing.
Geotek will continue to supply FHMA-related systems worldwide, purchasing systems supplied HNS and Rafael, Israel's Armament Development Authority.
"This is the first significant commitment of vendor credit to support the deployment of FHMA technology," said Yaron Eitan, president and chief executive of Geotek.
"The addition of $100 million of available vendor credit represents a major milestone in our fund-raising efforts," added chief financial officer Michael McCoy.
HNS, a unit of Hughes Electronic Corp, will begin supplying FHMA equipment in 1997. Hughes is part of General Motors Corp.
The agreement expands an existing partnership between the two companies in which HNS has developed and manufactured subscriber terminals for Geotek's FHMA network.
Geotek is a wireless communications company. Its FHMA technology is the basis for its network systems, mobile terminals, infrastructure equipment and software for the commercial mobile radio market.
